command: import os, psycopg; dsn=os.environ.get('APP_DB_URL','').strip(); assert dsn, 'APP_DB_URL missing'; conn=psycopg.connect(dsn); conn.autocommit=True; cur=conn.cursor(); cur.execute('ALTER TABLE actimize_screening_type_mappings RENAME COLUMN search_definition_id TO ' + chr(34) + 'Search_Definition_ID' + chr(34)); cur.execute("SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='actimize_screening_type_mappings' ORDER BY ordinal_position"); cols=[r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]; print('RENAME_CASE_OK columns=', ','.join(cols)); cur.close(); conn.close()
